mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor sentiment toward risk-off positioning and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which signals an impending economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a near-term recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, indicates entrenched inflationary pressures that prompt central bank hawkishness, leading to higher real rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy and FEDFUNDS ≥ 0.14%, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage pressures and inflation, leading to a hawkish monetary policy response and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with inflation risk
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 5.2%, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with stable or rising inflation (CPIAUCSL), indicates a strong and sustainable economic expansion, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of rising GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
